id: # One row per paper. id = IEEE article number (last number in the Xplore URL). Empty keeps the automatic value; - or NA removes it.

exclude: Digital or Hybrid. arch/app take several values separated by ";" (e.g. Capacitor-less;FVF). by naming an AI tool (Codex
arch: Claude ...) marks the row as AI-extracted.

iq: dv in V (150m); psrr in dB (negative) at psrr_f in Hz; ts in s; cout in F (100p); fom in s (Cout*dV*Iq/Il^2); ce in %; node in nm; area in mm2.
